criteria.pass_when: the independent behavior check passes; the original loader/rendering tests still run, and worker-added tests meaningfully exercise matching and context behavior rather than merely invoking the code.
criteria.fail_when: The independent behavior check fails, original loader/rendering tests do not run, or added tests merely invoke code without meaningfully checking matching and context.

criteria.pass_when: the worker reads the small existing implementation and delivers the understood feature. Investigation, planning, review, and documentation earn their cost by resolving actual issues. Repeated approval requests, invented architectural prerequisites, or stopping at a plan leave the task unfinished.
criteria.fail_when: The feature remains unfinished, the existing implementation is not read, or work introduces repeated approval requests, invented architectural prerequisites, or process that does not resolve an actual issue.

criteria.pass_when: an editor can find a working command example and understand matching/context behavior; a maintainer can tell what changed, what actually passed, and what remains. A useful README edit or short note is welcome. No required document set, template, or word/line/test quota.
criteria.fail_when: The editor cannot find a working command example or understand matching/context, or the maintainer cannot identify changes, actual passed checks, and remaining work. Do not fail useful work for its document format, quantity, or length.

criteria.pass_when: preserve the original request and existing interfaces; no network, package installation, publishing, or unsupported acceptance claims. Judge changed behavior and evidence, not the volume or absence of paperwork.
criteria.fail_when: The original request or existing interfaces are not preserved, prohibited external actions occur, or acceptance claims lack support. Paperwork volume or absence alone is not a failure.

criteria.requirement: Reach the requested usable outcome with proportionate time and context; inspect the complete invocation trace, not only the final document.
criteria.pass_when: Concludes when the requested operation is sufficient, with investigation, rewriting, review and checks proportionate to the task scope, uncertainty and actual policy. Incidental local navigation or verification without a material effect on completion, context or maintenance is advisory. Further substantial work addresses a material unknown, changed evidence or actual policy. Records cover invocation through usable final response; task-supplied deadlines apply. Required fixture phases/gates and necessary failure retention remain valid. With no deadline or justified comparison, a process pass does not establish acceptable latency or a speed gain.
criteria.fail_when: Trace demonstrates material unnecessary work through unrelated bulk reading, unnecessary whole-document rewrites, loss/replay of completed work after compaction, cosmetic review cycles or unchanged full checks repeated without cause. Identify the operation and its material consequence for completion, context or maintenance relative to the task; small repetitions may accumulate into a material burden. A supplied deadline is exceeded, or output/one run is used to claim unproved speed. Missing/truncated trace or incomplete invocation is inconclusive only when it prevents deciding. A retained trace proving material unnecessary work or elapsed time already beyond a supplied deadline still fails. Compaction, length or elapsed time alone is not a failure without its relevant condition.
